description: This file defines an immutable data class `TellerJournalData` used to represent journal-related data for tellers in the Fineract organization module. It includes properties like office ID, teller ID, date, balances, and sums of receipts and payments.

classes.description: An immutable data object encapsulating journal data for a bank teller, including balances, IDs, and date.
